plan.name: The 20-Week Integrated Strength Program (V26.9: Longevity Update)
plan.description: A comprehensive strength program optimized for the 40+ athlete, focusing on elite pulling strength while maintaining joint longevity. Features a 20-week progression through Foundation, Intensification, Neutral Grip, Accumulation, and Peak phases. Every session is fully detailed with specific warmups and cool-downs.
plan.author: System Generated

phases.name: Block 1: Foundation
phases.description: Establish volume baseline (36–40 reps) without tendon agitation and reinforce healthy squat patterns.

weeks.description: Establishing the volume baseline with moderate intensity.

exercises.notes: Global Tendon Prep. Pin elbow to ribcage.
3s ISO-HOLD at top. No bouncy reps.
Focus on breathing into lower back.

weeks.description: Increasing metabolic accumulation; lower intensity on core.
Peak volume for the block; focus on perfect ladder execution.
System reset. Volume dropped by 40%.

phases.name: Block 2: Intensification
phases.description: Transition to density-based volume (EMOMs) and increase pushing capacity.

weeks.description: Moderate intensity start, EMOM volume introduction.
Volume peak for EMOMs.
Intensity Peak. Shifting to triples for speed.
Standard deload. Focus on mobility.

phases.name: Block 3: Neutral Grip Integration
phases.description: Protect distal biceps tendon by mandating Neutral Grip and develop unilateral stability.

weeks.description: Introduction to Clusters and Neutral Grip pulling.
Elbow protection week. Isometric focus.
Return to Neutral Grip intensity.
Connective Tissue Deload. System reset.

exercises.notes: NO Dead Hangs. NO Weighted Core.

phases.name: Block 4: Accumulation
phases.description: Peak absolute strength testing and AMRAPs.

weeks.description: Re-introducing AMRAPs with strict technical caps.
Increasing intensity on AMRAPs and Dips.
Peak Volume & Load. All-out effort week.
Deload. Significant volume cut.

phases.name: Block 5: Peak & Taper
phases.description: Sharpen neural drive for the final test and minimize joint stress.

weeks.description: High intensity, reduced joint stress variations.
Tapering + Archer Negative Peak.
The calm before the test. 50% volume.
TEST WEEK.
